reconcile.note: Matthew Henry argues Paul delegated baptism to co-workers so he could focus on preaching, not that he slighted Jesus's baptismal commission.

sides.snippet: Therefore go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
sides.verseText: Therefore go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

sides.snippet: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Gospel--not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn't be made void.
sides.verseText: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Gospel--not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn't be made void.
